findings.title: Light-theme color changed from 30% to 70% in topic-meta-data link
findings.body: In app/assets/stylesheets/desktop/topic-post.scss line 291 the original rule was color: scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%). The change made it dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 70%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 30%)). The first argument to dark-light-choose is used for light themes and must preserve the original 30% value to avoid a visual regression. Using 70% makes the link much lighter on light backgrounds, reducing contrast and readability. It should be 30% / 70%.

findings.title: Group member name light-theme lightness changed 30% to 50%
findings.body: In app/assets/stylesheets/desktop/user.scss line 522 (.group-member-info .name) the original was scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%). It was replaced with dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 50%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 50%)). The light-theme branch no longer matches the original, changing the established light-theme appearance, and it breaks the convention used elsewhere in the PR where light/dark lightness sums to 100 (30/70). It should be 30% / 70%.

findings.title: Custom-message-length light value inverted from 70% to 30%
findings.body: In app/assets/stylesheets/mobile/modal.scss line 102 the original was scale-color($primary, $lightness: 70%). It became dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 70%)). The light-theme value changed from 70% to 30%, making text much darker on light themes, and it is inconsistent with the desktop counterpart in desktop/modal.scss which correctly uses 70% / 30%. It should be 70% / 30%.

findings.title: Topic-map h3 light-theme lightness changed 20% to 50%
findings.body: In app/assets/stylesheets/mobile/topic-post.scss line 182 (.topic-map h3) the original was scale-color($primary, $lightness: 20%). It was replaced with dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 50%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 50%)). The light-theme color is now much lighter than before, reducing contrast on light backgrounds, and it breaks the 100-sum convention (should be 20% / 80% as used for the same element on desktop). It should be 20% / 80%.

findings.title: Group member name light-theme lightness changed 30% to 50% on mobile
findings.body: In app/assets/stylesheets/mobile/user.scss line 497 (.group-member-info .name) the original was scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%). It became dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 50%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 50%)). The light-theme branch does not preserve the original 30% value, causing an unintended light-theme color shift and breaking the 30% / 70% pattern used for this element elsewhere. It should be 30% / 70%.
